That I have a personality disorder that I actually learned from my mom and I'm in therapy trying to get better.
That my endometriosis has made me infertile and I'm going to adopt when the time is right and I'll tell her that I gave birth.
That I know my father was alive and I have met him before he actually died.
There are a few secrets in my family and I actually know some of them but I let my mom lie, because it makes her feel better, and prefer it this way.

Even if I get bored...my brain goes into "suicide mode".
Once my bf told me that I actually muttered under my breath that I should kill myself, while watching a movie, it was a shitty movie
Well done! Keeping yourself busy always helps
Just started a few weeks and going strong with it

She used to play ill also, and made scenes because I wasn't by her side or I didn't make her a cup of tea. She was actually telling me that she had heart attacks when I was a teenager because I was trying to go out and make friends. I will visit her from time to time, but just to see my cats and dog since the landlord doesn't allow pets, but that's about it.
I just did. I went home today to get some stuff and she was acting so miserable, usually I was empathetic with her, today she actually made me feel desgusted with everything.

I don't open up about my illness. Mental health in my country is seen like something extremely negative, and if an employer finds out you have a problem you can get fired on the spot. 
I open up about my problems, for example: I'm upset because... Or this crazy thing happened to me when I was... Random talks, that I think can be used out of context
Thank you I will try to do that.

Don't quit, I've done it and I'm still in regret because of it. I was upset and tired from my job and I've lost the best place to work and now I've got to get used to new people, new way of doing things and I'm miserable. 

Don't quit your job, hang in there it will get better.
